user.title: Sign in to myEnergy
user.description: Use the email and password you use at myenergy.powercor.com.au. The password is only used to sign in and is not stored.

method.title: Verification code
method.description:
Choose where myEnergy should send your verification code.

{detail}

code.title: Enter the verification code
code.description:
myEnergy sent a {digits}-digit code by {method}. Enter it below, or tick resend to have a new one sent.

{detail}

nmi.title: Choose a meter
nmi.description: This login can see more than one NMI. Choose the one to import.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to myEnergy again
reauth_confirm.description: The myEnergy session has ended. Sign in again to resume importing readings; a new verification code will be sent.

error.invalid_auth: myEnergy did not accept that email address or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach myEnergy. Try again shortly.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. The log has the details.
error.send_failed: myEnergy could not send a code that way. Try the other option.
error.code_resent: A new code has been sent.
error.invalid_code: myEnergy did not accept that code.

abort.already_configured: This NMI is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: Signed in again. Readings will resume.
abort.wrong_account: That login cannot see the NMI this entry follows.
abort.no_nmis: This login has no active NMIs with energy usage data.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach myEnergy. Try again shortly.
abort.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. The log has the details.

init.title: Session keep-alive
init.description: myEnergy ends a session after two hours idle, and Salesforce only extends a session when a request comes in the second half of that time. Keep this under 60 minutes.
